# Smithsonian Magazine

> > Smithsonian Magazine's digital platform exploring history, science, arts, culture, archaeology, astronomy, and wildlife research through in-depth articles and smart news coverage.

Smithsonian Magazine is the official publication of the Smithsonian Institution, offering authoritative journalism and storytelling across diverse fields of human knowledge and natural history. The magazine combines long-form feature articles with timely smart news updates, covering everything from archaeological discoveries to astronomical phenomena.

## Key Topics

- History articles and historical research
- Science news and discoveries
- Cultural content and arts coverage
- Smart news (timely updates)
- Wildlife research and natural history
- Archaeology and anthropology
- Astronomy and space exploration
- North American history and culture
- Global cultural heritage
- Museum collections and exhibitions
- Innovation and technology
- Environmental science
- World history
- Arts and humanities

## Main

- [Smithsonian Magazine Homepage](https://www.smithsonianmag.com): Main homepage featuring the latest articles on history, science, arts, culture, archaeology, astronomy, and wildlife research

## History

- [History Articles](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/history/): In-depth historical articles covering world history, American history, and cultural heritage

## Science & Nature

- [Science News](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/science-nature/): Coverage of scientific discoveries, wildlife research, astronomy, archaeology, and environmental science

## Arts & Culture

- [Arts & Culture](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/arts-culture/): Exploration of visual arts, performing arts, literature, and cultural movements worldwide

## Smart News

- [Smart News](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/): Timely news updates and breaking stories across all subject areas covered by the magazine
